name: 美國 ISM 製造業 PMI
text: The ISM Manufacturing PMI climbed to 55.5 in October 2026, up from 54.5 in September and comfortably exceeding market expectations of 54.6. The reading marked the sector's second-fastest pace of expansion in nearly four years, driven primarily by stronger output growth, with the Production Index rising to 59.0 from 56.7.

name: 美國 ISM 服務業 PMI
text: The ISM Services PMI decreased to 54.5 in October 2026, the lowest in three months, compared to 54.9 in September and forecasts of 54.8. The reading pointed to a slowdown in services growth, due to business activity (53.8 vs 56.5), new orders (55.9 vs 59.8), and inventories (55.4 vs 57.8).

name: 台灣製造業 PMI
text: The S&P Global Taiwan Manufacturing PMI fell to 54.9 in October 2026 from a more than five-year high of 56.7 in the previous month. Nevertheless, it marked the eleventh consecutive month of expansion, supported by continued growth in new orders amid improving demand conditions across domestic and export markets.

name: CPI 年增率
text: The annual change in US CPI for October 2026 was not published alongside the November 10 release, following an earlier announcement by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) that it would not report 12-month percentage changes for indexes lacking October 2025 data. The federal government shutdown, prevented the collection and publication of CPI data for October 2025.

name: CPI 月增率
text: US consumer inflation moderated in October, with the CPI rising 0.4% month on month, after a 0.6% increase in September, and above forecasts of 0.3%. Meanwhile, core inflation rose 0.3%, matching the pace recorded in August and September, but above expectations of 0.2%.

name: 核心 CPI 年增率
text: The annual change in US core CPI for October 2026 was not published alongside the November 10 release, following an earlier announcement by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) that it would not report 12-month percentage changes for indexes lacking October 2025 data. This follows the federal government shutdown, which disrupted the collection of CPI data for that month, preventing the calculation of annual core inflation rates.

name: 核心 CPI 月增率
text: Core consumer prices in the United States, which exclude food and energy goods, rose by 0.3% for the third consecutive month in October of 2026, above market expectations of 0.2%. Prices rose sharply for a second month in transportation services (0.8% vs 0.6% in September), indicating that higher oil and fuel prices in the wholesale market is being transmitted into core sectors of the transportation sector.

name: PPI 年增率
text: Producer prices in the United States rose by 6.5% from the previous year in October of 2026, the most since November of 2022, as the surge in energy prices from the war in the Middle East lifted costs for US factories. The result was slightly under market expectations of 6.6%.

name: PPI 月增率
text: US producer prices rose 0.3% month-over-month in October 2026, easing sharply from an upwardly revised 1.4% increase in September and coming in below market expectations of 0.4%, largely reflecting moderating energy price pressures. Goods inflation slowed to 0.5% from 2.5% in September, as energy prices fell 0.1% following a 10.0% surge in the previous month.

name: 核心 PPI 年增率
text: Core producer inflation in the United States, which exclude food and energy goods, held at 5% for a second month in October 2026, matching expectations and remaining at its highest level since early 2023. source: U.S.

name: PCE 年增率
text: US PCE inflation accelerated to 3.6% year-on-year in September 2026 from 3.4% in August, in line with market expectations. Core PCE inflation, which excludes food and energy, picked up to 3.1% from 3%.

name: 核心 PCE 年增率
text: The US core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of underlying inflation, rose 3.1% year over year in September 2026, up from 3.0% in August and in line with market expectations. On a monthly basis, core PCE prices increased 0.3%, matching both the previous month's rise and forecasts.

name: 核心 PCE 月增率
text: The US core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of underlying inflation, rose 0.3% month over month in September 2026, matching both August's increase and market expectations. On an annual basis, core PCE inflation accelerated to 3.1% from 3.0% in August, in line with forecasts and marking its highest level since May.

name: 個人消費支出月增率
text: US personal consumption expenditures increased by 0.5% in September 2026, following a 0.9% rise in August and coming slightly below forecasts of 0.6%. The $113.1 billion increase in current-dollar PCE in September reflected increases of $35.1 billion in spending on goods and $78.1 billion in spending on services.

name: 失業率
text: The US unemployment rate eased to 4.1% in October 2026, down from 4.2% in September and slightly below market expectations of 4.2%. The number of unemployed fell by 41,000 to 7.07 million, while total employment jumped by 463,000 to 163.62 million, pointing to continued strength in the labor market.

name: 非農就業人數
text: The US economy added 165K jobs in October 2026, following an upwardly revised 60K increase in September, and well above market forecasts of 65K. The figure is also higher than the average monthly gain of 48K over the prior 12 months.

name: 聯準會利率決策
text: The Federal Reserve left the federal funds rate unchanged at 3.75%–4.00% at its October 2026 meeting, following a 25bps hike in September, which was the first rate increase since 2023. The decision came in line with market expectations but two policymakers voted for a 25bps rate hike.
